    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AbstractAtomSpi
    Skeletal implementation of AtomSpi providing key-prefix management and a no-op sweep default.
    AbstractHandoff<T>
    Base class that factors out the shared machinery of Handoff implementations: the lock, the notEmpty condition, the sticky terminal field, the AbstractHandoff.poll(Duration) deadline/await loop, and the terminal-marker methods.
    AbstractJournalSpi
    Skeletal implementation of JournalSpi providing key-prefix management, UUID v7 entry-ID generation, a no-op create default, and a no-op sweep default.
    AbstractMailboxSpi
    Skeletal implementation of MailboxSpi providing key-prefix management and a no-op sweep default.
    AesGcmPayloadTransformer
    AES-GCM payload transformer that encrypts and decrypts payload bytes using keys resolved via a SecretKeyResolver.
    Atom<T>
    A distributed AtomicReference with TTL-based leases and change notification.
    AtomAlreadyExistsException
    Thrown by AtomFactory.create when an atom with the given name already exists in the backend.
    AtomContext
    Shared infrastructure passed into every DefaultAtom instance produced by a DefaultAtomFactory.
    AtomEntry
     
    AtomExpiredException
    Thrown when an operation is attempted on an Atom whose TTL has elapsed or that has been explicitly deleted.
    AtomFactory
    Factory for constructing and connecting to Atom instances.
    AtomNotFoundException
    Thrown when the first operation on a handle obtained from AtomFactory.connect finds that no atom exists at the given name.
    AtomSpi
    Backend SPI for Atom storage operations.
    BlockingSubscription<T>
    A pull-based Subscription where the caller explicitly polls for values by calling BlockingSubscription.next(Duration).
    BoundedQueueHandoff<T>
    FIFO bounded-queue handoff.
    CallbackPumpSubscription<T>
    A thin push-style wrapper around a BlockingSubscription that dispatches each NextResult to a Subscriber on a dedicated virtual thread.
    CasResult
    Outcome of a conditional compareAndSet write.

    CompareAndSetProcessor
    Compares an atom's token and, on a match, writes the new value and TTL — all as a single partition-local operation, so no concurrent writer can interleave.
    ConfiguredSubscriber<T>
    Immutable Subscriber implementation backed by individually registered handler fields.
    DefaultAtom<T>
    Default Atom handle: a single value at a key, read and replaced under a staleness token so concurrent writers detect each other.
    DefaultAtomFactory
    Default AtomFactory, creating and attaching DefaultAtom handles.
    DefaultBlockingSubscription<T>
    Default BlockingSubscription: callers pull the next value, blocking until one arrives, the subscription ends, or the timeout elapses.
    DefaultJournal<T>
    Default Journal handle: an append-only sequence at a key, read forward from a cursor and closed by completing it.
    DefaultJournalFactory
    Default JournalFactory, creating and attaching DefaultJournal handles.
    DefaultMailbox<T>
    Default Mailbox handle: a single-slot drop box at a key, where each delivery replaces whatever was waiting.
    DefaultMailboxFactory
    Default MailboxFactory, creating and attaching DefaultMailbox handles.
    DefaultNotifier
    Default Notifier, routing every primitive's notifications over a single NotifierSpi transport by encoding the primitive, key and kind into the payload.
    DefaultSubscriberBuilder<T>
    Mutable builder that implements SubscriberConfig and materializes a ConfiguredSubscriber via DefaultSubscriberBuilder.build().

    InMemoryAtomSpi
    In-process AtomSpi fallback.
    InMemoryJournalSpi
    In-process JournalSpi fallback, and the reference implementation of the journal lifecycle: inactivity and retention leases, per-entry TTLs, and tombstones so a read just after a journal dies reports the expiry rather than an empty journal.
    InMemoryMailboxSpi
    In-process MailboxSpi fallback.
    InMemoryNotifier
    In-process NotifierSpi fallback.
    Journal<T>
    A distributed append-only event stream with per-entry TTLs, a completion lifecycle, and monotonic ordering.
    JournalAlreadyExistsException
    Thrown by JournalFactory.create when a journal with the requested name already exists in the backend.
    JournalCompletedException
    Thrown when append is called on a journal that has already been completed.
    JournalContext
    Shared infrastructure passed into every DefaultJournal instance produced by a DefaultJournalFactory.
    JournalEntry<T>
    A single entry in a Journal, containing the deserialized payload, the entry's unique monotonic ID, the journal key, and the append timestamp.
    JournalExpiredException
    Thrown when an operation targets a Journal that has expired due to inactivity or post-completion retention TTL elapsing, or that has been explicitly deleted.
    JournalFactory
    Factory for constructing and connecting to Journal instances.
    JournalLimits
    Bundles the configurable upper bounds a DefaultJournalFactory enforces on the journals it creates and the DefaultJournal instances it constructs.
    JournalNotFoundException
    Thrown when the first operation on a handle obtained from JournalFactory.connect finds that no journal exists at the given name.
    JournalSpi
    Backend SPI for Journal storage operations.
    Mailbox<T>
    A distributed single-delivery mailbox with TTL-based expiration.
    MailboxContext
    Shared infrastructure passed into every DefaultMailbox instance produced by a DefaultMailboxFactory.
    MailboxExpiredException
    Thrown when an operation such as Mailbox.deliver(Object) is attempted on a mailbox whose TTL has elapsed or that has been explicitly deleted.
    MailboxFactory
    Factory for constructing and connecting to Mailbox instances.
    MailboxFullException
    Thrown when Mailbox.deliver(Object) is called on a mailbox that has already received its single delivery.
    MailboxNotFoundException
    Thrown when the first operation on a handle obtained from MailboxFactory.connect finds that no mailbox exists at the given name.
    MailboxSpi
    Backend SPI for Mailbox storage operations.

    NextResult<T>
    Sealed outcome type returned by BlockingSubscription.next(java.time.Duration).
    NextResult.Cancelled<T>
    This subscription was torn down locally — via an explicit sub.cancel() call or by the substrate shutdown coordinator during Spring context close.
    NextResult.Completed<T>
    The underlying primitive completed naturally.
    NextResult.Deleted<T>
    The underlying primitive was explicitly deleted.
    NextResult.Errored<T>
    An unexpected backend error occurred.
    NextResult.Expired<T>
    The underlying primitive's TTL elapsed without renewal, causing it to expire.
    NextResult.Timeout<T>
    The specified timeout elapsed before a value became available.
    NextResult.Value<T>
    A new value was delivered from the underlying primitive.
    Notification
    Something that happened to a primitive at a given key, delivered to subscribers so they know to look again.
    Notification.Changed
    The value at this key was written: an atom set, a journal appended to, a mailbox filled.
    Notification.Completed
    The journal at this key was completed and will accept no further appends.
    Notification.Deleted
    The primitive at this key was deleted.
    Notifier
    Routes Notifications from the writer of a primitive to whoever is subscribed to it, across nodes when the backing transport spans them.
    NotifierSpi
    Backend SPI for opaque byte[] notification broadcasting.
    NotifierSubscription
    Handle for an active notification subscription, returned by NotifierSpi.subscribe.
    PayloadTransformer
    Transforms payload bytes on their way to and from the backend SPI.
